title: Validator Structured Report
description: Canonical machine-readable output of `python -m ledgerlinc_ocr.validator ... --json`. Consumed by the harness, CI, and regression gates. Frozen at contract-set 1.0.0.

report_version.description: Semver of the report schema itself. 1.0.0 for this contract set.

contract_set_version_checked.description: The contract-set version this validation was performed against.

passed.description: True iff no error-severity violations exist. Warnings alone do not cause passed=false.

warnings.description: Warning-severity findings. May be non-empty even when passed=true (e.g. missing notes.md for an easy/medium document).

counts.description: Aggregate counts for quick consumption by harness dashboards.

sub_reports.description: Present only for `corpus:...` targets. One entry per folder or root-level artifact validated in the corpus run.

target.description: Artifact name (e.g. `edge_extraction_output`) or a folder path. Matches the scope of the violation, which may differ from the top-level `target_summary` when a corpus report aggregates sub-targets.

field_path.description: JSON Pointer-style path into the artifact (e.g. `/vendor_candidate/company_name/value`). Empty string for artifact-level or folder-level issues that do not point at a single field.

violation_code.description: Stable machine code from the violation-code vocabulary frozen at this contract-set version.

reason.description: Human-readable sentence suitable for CLI rendering and for labelers.

expected.description: The rule or contract name being violated (e.g. `FR-012 tax_ids enum`, `FR-029 notes.md conditional`). Nullable when not meaningfully applicable.

source_file.description: Path to the offending artifact file, when the violation is file-scoped. Enables corpus-level aggregation without recomputing.
